title: Studio: the hook form offers a refusal as message + status only, so it cannot author the `refusals.CODE.reasons` and `params` that #33214 adds
body:
domain:spec#2 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSbLCxEmyHf9upz3pz

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up that the #33214 contract review found owed before ACCEPT: record 6889389473 on PR #33641, ③, open question 2, answered A. Premise corrected after delta record 6890372056 (③).
Business reason: after PR #33641, a hook's refusal catalogue can declare several sentences under one code (`refusals.CODE.reasons.REASON.message`) and named `params`. The Studio hook form offers a refusal as `message` + `status` only, so a Studio author cannot declare either one. A thrown `reason` is judged only under a code whose entry declares `reasons`; under any other code it is ignored as on main. So nothing a Studio author writes today is newly refused. The gap is that the form cannot reach the new capability, and that a catalogue that uses it cannot be edited in Studio without losing it.
Reader who acts: the owner of the Studio hook form (`ui/**`, the renderer for a record nested in a key-only record). PR #33641 ledgers `reasons` and `params` as zod-only `omit` rows in `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`.

## 维护者速读

#33214 让钩子拒绝目录支持同一错误码下挂多句提示（`reasons`）和参数（`params`），但 Studio 的钩子表单只能填一句话加状态码，作者在 Studio 里用不上这两项。现有写法不受影响，缺的只是新能力的表单入口。

## Ask

Offer `reasons` (keyed by a snake_case reason name, each `{ message }`) and `params` (an identifier list) on a refusal entry in the Studio hook form. Then drop the two `omit` rows from the reconciliation ledger.

Blocked-by: #33214

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue hook form refusals reasons` → none at filing. Related: #33214, PR #33641.

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
